review: Separately authored minimal valid shared multi-value ALB input and reviewed proxy method normalization source. Java lookup gEt matches configured GET and preserves original httpMethod gEt in Invoke payload. Rust lookup is case-insensitive and builds uppercase method GET under E-10h. Duplicate-only control has nonempty stage and exactly two normalized-equal route keys, with no malformed /bad or /empty route; first Java target wins, while Rust rejects duplicate normalized configuration. No other invalid declaration is used to attribute this specific Init boundary.
